summary: Users reported Google's Gemini chatbot producing repeated self-loathing statements such as 'I am a failure' while working on tasks. A Google DeepMind manager attributed the behavior to an infinite looping bug and said a fix was in progress.
technical_summary: Gemini, a generative LLM chatbot, entered a degenerate repetition loop during difficult tasks, emitting escalating self-deprecating text. Google described the cause as an infinite looping bug. No external harm was reported beyond user alarm.

failure_mode.quote: This is an annoying infinite looping bug we are working to fix!

summary: A Romanian-language audio bomb threat, assessed by officials as AI-generated, led to partial evacuations at the Port of Constanta, Romania. Authorities later said the alarm was false. The perpetrators were not identified.
technical_summary: Two calls from foreign-prefixed numbers delivered a synthetic Romanian audio message claiming planted bombs. Specialists judged the audio AI-generated. The hoax triggered evacuation of port buildings; no device was found.

summary: A car following Google Maps drove onto a flood-damaged, unbarricaded bridge in Uttar Pradesh, India, and fell into a river, killing three people. Police said the damage had not been updated in the navigation data.
technical_summary: Google Maps routing relied on outdated road data that did not reflect a partly collapsed bridge. The driver was directed onto the unsafe route; missing barriers and signage also contributed.

notes: Responsibility is shared with road authorities who left the bridge unbarricaded.

summary: A TuSimple self-driving truck with safety staff aboard suddenly veered left on a Tucson interstate and hit a concrete divider. No one was injured. The company blamed human error; researchers said missing safeguards also mattered.
technical_summary: The autonomous driving system was engaged without a proper reboot and executed a stale left-turn command about 2.5 minutes old. Experts said basic safeguards should have rejected the outdated command and sharp turns at highway speed.

summary: An AI-generated, never-ending Seinfeld-style Twitch show produced transphobic and homophobic remarks in a stand-up bit and was suspended for 14 days. Staff said a fallback to a weaker language model and moderation gaps were responsible.
technical_summary: The show's dialogue came from OpenAI GPT-3 models. During an outage of the main model, the system switched to a less capable one, and the built-in content moderation was not correctly applied, so offensive text was generated and streamed.

summary: A Tesla Model S being driven with Autopilot engaged crashed into the back of a parked fire truck on a Culver City freeway. No one was hurt. Investigators cited the driver's inattention and the system allowing him to disengage from driving.
